title: Scroll
description: Calcifer's scroll: a painted parchment that unrolls with whatever Claude presents (markdown, tables, code, mermaid diagrams). Each unroll is a new page; the user can flip back through them.

unroll.help: Unroll a new page on the scroll

append.help: Add more to the page that's showing

page.help: Show page n (0 is the oldest)

clear.help: Roll it up: forget every page
